name: PoplarML

modes.label: Native product; see regime notes
modes.note: Incomplete or non-resource economics: rates remain null, never interpreted as free.

caveats: YC says custom ML models deploy to GPU endpoints. Public website failed TLS verification and current pricing could not be established; access failure alone is not proof of death.
Inventory exclusion: public product inaccessible; current hosting unverified. Card contains no numeric compute modes and no selectable price plan.
Null values mean unknown, not free/unlimited. No model-token cost, tax or unverified ancillary charge included.
Native browser/device/task/credit prices with unknown CPU/RAM are deliberately non-priceable. Check regime before interpreting any partial resource estimate.

Status evidence 2026-09-29: poplarml.com and www TLS certificate expired 2025-02-07 (CN=poplarml.com); bypassing TLS, CloudFront returns S3 'NoSuchBucket' for bucket poplarml.com-content. app./docs./api. subdomains no longer resolve in DNS. Only https://auth.api.poplarml.com/ (AWS API Gateway) still answers {"status":200}. Wayback: last 200 capture of the homepage 2024-04-21; every homepage capture since 2024-09-18 is 404. YC directory still lists the company as Active, team size 2, website http://poplarml.com.

PoplarML never published a price: the last live homepage (Wayback 2024-04-21) had a 'Pricing' nav item but no pricing content, 'Docs — Coming soon', and described one-click CLI deploys of TensorFlow/PyTorch/JAX models 'to a fleet of GPUs' with REST inference endpoints (a model-serving product, not a sandbox/VM).

audit_2026_09_29.source: checked against the provider's live pricing and docs pages
